newsitem.title: USA: Ford sets N.American output at 958,000 units.
newsitem.headline: Ford sets N.American output at 958,000 units.

text.p: Ford Motor Co said Thursday it expects to build 958,000 cars and trucks in North America in the third quarter, unchanged from its previous estimate for the period.
Ford's forecast includes 378,000 cars and 580,000 trucks.
A year ago, Ford built 416,000 cars and 533,000 trucks for a total of 949,000 vehicles. The most recent forecast represents a one percent increase from the year-ago period.
Detroit's Big Three have projected they will produce 2,854,900 vehicles in the third quarter. That is up one percent from the output in the comparable 1996 period.
